action_reference:
Available action types:

1. humanDecision — collects user input
   Fields: id, type, prompt

2. scramda2 — AI text generation
   Fields: id, type, prompt, examples (array), modelProfile (orchestrator|reports|code|chat|default), includedData

3. workflow — runs a sub-workflow file
   Fields: id, type, file (relative path), outputKey, includedData

4. loop — runs an iteration file repeatedly
   Fields: id, type, file (relative path), iterations (number, 0=infinite), continueKey (stop when falsy), outputKey, includedData

5. loadContext — loads a JSON file, merges all keys into context
   Fields: id, type, file (relative path)

6. writeFile — saves content to a file
   Fields: id, type, file (output path with {var} substitution), content (key name to write), includedData

7. shell — runs a whitelisted shell command
   Fields: id, type, command, timeout

8. runCode — executes python/bash/node code
   Fields: id, type, language (python|bash|node), source (code string), stdin (key name), includedData

9. browseWeb — fetches a web page
   Fields: id, type, urlKey (key containing URL), includedData

10. writeMemory — saves to persistent memory
    Fields: id, type, namespace, titleKey, contentKey, includedData

11. searchMemory — searches persistent memory
    Fields: id, type, namespace, queryKey, maxResults

12. humanShell — like shell but always prompts human for approval
    Fields: id, type, command, skipValue, timeout

13. deriveTags — extracts tags from text
    Fields: id, type, contentKey, includedData

Workflow JSON structure:
{
  "autoContext": "optional system prompt for --auto mode",
  "defaults": {"key": "default_value"},
  "workflow": {"steps": ["step1", "step2"]},
  "actionSets": {
    "step1": [{action}, {action}],
    "step2": [{action}]
  }
}

includedData: array of keys to pass to handler. Supports alias: 'newName=oldKey.subKey'
modelProfile: orchestrator (reasoning), reports (writing), code (programming), chat (dialogue), default (fast/cheap)
